title: Move bundle-size reporting out of worker dev into a standalone script
reason: Requests removing redundant bundle-size esbuild watch processes from upstream Cloudflare worker dev sessions. This is dotcom developer tooling and has no discussion.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no corresponding Cloudflare workers; no local change is indicated.

title: Flatten the sync-worker dev wrapper to drop an extra process layer
reason: Proposes simplifying the upstream sync-worker dev command to remove an extra package-script and tsx process hop. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Specific to upstream worker scripts and not applicable to Varve's application runtime.

title: Re-evaluate the MiniflareMonitor segfault-restart wrapper for workers
reason: Asks whether an upstream wrangler wrapper that restarts after workerd segmentation faults is still necessary. It is a maintenance and reliability decision for their Cloudflare dev environment.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not use this wrapper or workerd path; no implementation transfer is justified.

title: Support running the tldraw.com client against the staging backend for UI work
reason: Requests a client-only Vite configuration targeting tldraw.com's staging backend to avoid running local workers and databases. The sole response says it is a reasonable idea without confirmation of implementation.

varveAssessment.assessment: This targets tldraw.com development infrastructure and does not imply a Varve feature or marketing-site change.

title: Nested dismissable layers conflict: clicking out of a select dropdown inside a modal also dismisses the modal
reason: The maintainer confirms #9269 fixed the issue by using Radix layer-aware dismissal for SDK dialogs, so clicking outside the nested select only closes that select.

varveAssessment.assessment: The upstream Radix dialog behavior is not evidence of a Varve regression.

title: Dragging a handle on a line whose point keys differ from their indices crashes the editor
reason: The reporter corrects the initial group/line theory: the actual trigger is fractional point indices whose map keys differ from indices; the discussion asks for reproduction details and provides a follow-up example. The final explanation must replace the initial incorrect theory.

varveAssessment.assessment: This depends on upstream line-point map/index invariants. No analogous Varve line schema defect was inspected or reproduced.

title: Not possible to create email-based account due to Cloudflare popup
reason: The first reply apologizes and the second confirms a fix in #9253 with a planned rollout. The report concerns Cloudflare verification layered over upstream account creation.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not provide upstream tldraw.com account creation; no local code change is indicated.

title: Inconsistent icon stroke weights in the tldraw.com sidebar menu
reason: The sole comment says the icons look the same now except for the top two, suggesting substantial visual correction but leaving a minor comparison unresolved. The linked screenshot was not independently inspected.

varveAssessment.assessment: A visual polish report for upstream dotcom; no Varve icon inconsistency was measured.

title: Sidebar logo link button extends well beyond the logo
reason: Discussion agrees the clickable logo region should match the logo but questions whether it should link to tldraw.dev; a possible future destination is a recents screen. No settled destination or final fix is recorded.

varveAssessment.assessment: The upstream sidebar interaction is outside Varve's marketing-site shell and no local reproduction was performed.

title: Geo shapes with empty-array rich text are sized as if they contain a label
reason: Reports programmatically created upstream geo shapes growing to reserve label height for an empty rich-text paragraph. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve text geometry consumes `TextNode` paragraphs (`packages/shared/src/textGeometry.ts`) and has no matching tldraw geo-shape `onBeforeCreate` label measurement path. The reported schema/lifecycle bug is not directly analogous; no local change was made.
